correctness.rationale: The 16 coefficients of bidegree (3,3) over F2 encode all 65535 nonzero sections. A rational base fibre is a rational triple point iff its binary cubic mask is 1,8,15 (cubes of linear forms); this directly computes t_1,t_2. The obstruction to t_1+t_2>=4 enumerates 1128 masks: 1110 rationally singular; remaining 18 form one order-18 orbit represented by mask 6854 with an explicit singularity at (alpha,alpha+1) in F4. For full smoothness, finite-extension rational singular witnesses through degree six cover exactly 49515 masks; the remaining 16020 candidates split into 252 orbits of the 72-element split-quadric automorphism group. Each representative satisfies Groebner unit ideal (f,df/dx,df/dy) on each of 4 affine charts, establishing geometric smoothness beyond bounded-point tests. Audited C++ nullspace and Python orbit/Groebner code and recompiled/reproduced finite-field enumeration: smooth counts after degrees 1..6 were 18674,17984,16524,16308,16164,16020, and 252 orbits. All 1008 local Groebner unit-ideal checks passed. Independently reconstructed both binary outputs with exact matching Git blob IDs SHA1 ad56f5a... and ac915ea..., and matched all six weighted orbit census totals (5856/103,6912/96,1224/19,48/2,1620/27,360/5). The degree-4 zeta count derivation from Newton sums and reciprocal functional equation is valid and supported by the separate exact F2^d point checks for masks 6335 and 10685.
residual_risks: The computation is an exhaustive finite certificate on 2^16-1 masks, not a general theorem about all genus-four curves or nonsplit quadrics.
All 1008 Groebner computations used an independent local script after source inspection; no Lean/human attestation was performed.
